item.title: Why smart people stay stuck in research mode
item.author: Big Think
item.description:
Why: Why smart people over-research instead of starting, a sharp take on productivity. (score 8)

From Big Think.

I recently had coffee with a university colleague who told me she was in the middle of planning a workshop. She had bought a couple of books about hosting workshops, had created a spreadsheet projecting attendance under different scenarios, and was now comparing ticketing platforms. item.title: Trezor Warns of Suspected Hardware Implant in One of Its Wallets Sold by CryptoBilis
item.author: The Hacker News
item.description:
Why: A hardware implant that leaks wallet recovery phrases over cellular, a supply-chain attack on key storage. (score 8)

From The Hacker News.

A Trezor Safe 5 hardware wallet bought from the reseller CryptoBilis has an extra circuit board that sends out the recovery phrase over a mobile network, a customer has reported. Trezor has not yet examined the device. It is telling everyone who bought a Trezor from CryptoBilis since March 2026 to move their funds to a new wallet with a new recovery phrase.
